list.name: host
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT host FROM obs.family_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) ORDER BY host

list.name: family
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT family FROM obs.family_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) ORDER BY family

panels.title: Top digests

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.digest_id AS digest, any(t.digest_text) AS text, sum(s.calls) AS callCount,
  sum(s.cpu_ns) / 1e9 / greatest(dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime), 1) AS cpuCores,
  max(s.cpu_ns / greatest(dateDiff('second', s.window_start, s.window_end), 1)) / 1e9 AS peakCores,
  100 * sum(s.cpu_ns) / nullIf((SELECT sum(node_cpu_used_ns) FROM obs.host_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote})), 0) AS pctNodeCpu,
  sum(s.disk_read_bytes) / greatest(dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime), 1) / 1048576 AS readMBs,
  100 * sum(s.disk_read_bytes) / nullIf((SELECT sum(disk_read_bytes) FROM obs.host_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote})), 0) AS pctDiskRead,
  sum(s.disk_read_bytes) / greatest(sum(s.calls), 1) / 16384 AS pagesPerCall,
  sum(s.disk_write_bytes) / greatest(dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime), 1) / 1048576 AS writeMBs,
  100 * sum(s.runq_ns) / greatest(sum(s.wall_ns), 1) AS cpuWaitPct,
  100 * sum(s.io_wait_ns) / greatest(sum(s.wall_ns), 1) AS diskWaitPct,
  100 * sum(s.redo_wait_ns) / greatest(sum(s.wall_ns), 1) AS commitWaitPct,
  sum(s.wall_ns) / greatest(sum(s.calls), 1) / 1e6 AS latencyMsAvg,
  max(s.wall_max_ns) / 1e6 AS latencyMsMax,
  if(pctNodeCpu >= 20 AND 100 * (SELECT sum(node_cpu_used_ns) FROM obs.host_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote})) / nullIf((SELECT sum(cpu_count * dateDiff('second', window_start, window_end)) FROM obs.host_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote})) * 1e9, 0) >= 50, 'culprit', '') AS cpuRole,
  if(pctDiskRead >= 20 AND (SELECT sum(disk_read_bytes) FROM obs.host_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote})) / greatest(dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime), 1) / 1048576 >= 5, 'culprit', '') AS ioRole,
  multiIf(latencyMsAvg < ${slow_ms} OR cpuWaitPct + ifNull(diskWaitPct, 0) + ifNull(commitWaitPct, 0) < 50, '',
          cpuWaitPct >= ifNull(diskWaitPct, 0) AND cpuWaitPct >= ifNull(commitWaitPct, 0), 'cpu',
          ifNull(diskWaitPct, 0) >= ifNull(commitWaitPct, 0), 'disk', 'commit') AS victimOf
FROM obs.mysql_digest_stats AS s
LEFT JOIN (SELECT digest_id, digest_text FROM obs.mysql_digest_text FINAL) AS t ON t.digest_id = s.digest_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.window_end) AND s.host IN (${host:singlequote})
GROUP BY s.digest_id ORDER BY cpuCores DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description:
Formula: per digest over the selected range and hosts: cpuCores = cpu_ns ÷ range seconds (average cores busy); peakCores = the highest cpu_ns ÷ window of one flush interval on one host; pctNodeCpu = cpu_ns ÷ host_stats node_cpu_used_ns × 100; readMBs / writeMBs = disk bytes ÷ range seconds; pctDiskRead = disk_read_bytes ÷ host_stats disk_read_bytes × 100; pagesPerCall = disk_read_bytes per call ÷ 16384; cpuWaitPct / diskWaitPct / commitWaitPct = runq_ns / io_wait_ns / redo_wait_ns ÷ wall_ns × 100; latencyMsAvg = wall_ns per call, latencyMsMax = wall_max_ns. cpuRole = culprit when pctNodeCpu ≥ 20 and the node CPU was ≥ 50% used; ioRole = culprit when pctDiskRead ≥ 20 and the node read ≥ 5 MiB/s; victimOf = cpu / disk / commit (the largest wait) when latencyMsAvg ≥ slow_ms and the three waits are ≥ 50% of wall.
Reading: cpuCores is averaged over the whole range and dilutes a short burst: sort by peakCores to find bursts. A culprit consumes the resource; a victim only waited for it — fix culprits, not victims. pagesPerCall 1–4 = buffer-pool misses, hundreds = a scan. A NULL wait or % column means not measured (no delay accounting, no redo hooks, or no host_stats rows). slow_ms must equal mysql.slow_query_threshold_ms (dashboard settings → variables).

panels.title: % of node CPU used — top 10 digests

targets.rawSql:
SELECT d.time AS time, d.digest AS digest, 100 * d.v / nullIf(h.v, 0) AS pct
FROM (SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(toUInt32(window_end), greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s})) * greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}), 'UTC') AS time, digest_id AS digest, sum(cpu_ns) AS v FROM obs.mysql_digest_stats
      WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote})
        AND digest_id IN (SELECT digest_id FROM obs.mysql_digest_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote})
                          GROUP BY digest_id ORDER BY sum(cpu_ns) DESC LIMIT 10)
      GROUP BY time, digest) AS d
INNER JOIN (SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(toUInt32(window_end), greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s})) * greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}), 'UTC') AS time, sum(node_cpu_used_ns) AS v
            FROM obs.host_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) GROUP BY time) AS h ON h.time = d.time
ORDER BY time

panels.description:
Formula: per bucket (≥ flush interval): digest cpu_ns ÷ host_stats node_cpu_used_ns × 100, for the 10 digests with the most CPU over the range.
Reading: above 20% (and a busy node) a digest is a CPU culprit; a bucket without host_stats rows shows no point.

panels.title: % of node disk reads — top 10 digests

targets.rawSql:
SELECT d.time AS time, d.digest AS digest, 100 * d.v / nullIf(h.v, 0) AS pct
FROM (SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(toUInt32(window_end), greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s})) * greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}), 'UTC') AS time, digest_id AS digest, sum(disk_read_bytes) AS v FROM obs.mysql_digest_stats
      WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote})
        AND digest_id IN (SELECT digest_id FROM obs.mysql_digest_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote})
                          GROUP BY digest_id ORDER BY sum(disk_read_bytes) DESC LIMIT 10)
      GROUP BY time, digest) AS d
INNER JOIN (SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(toUInt32(window_end), greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s})) * greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}), 'UTC') AS time, sum(disk_read_bytes) AS v
            FROM obs.host_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) GROUP BY time) AS h ON h.time = d.time
ORDER BY time

panels.description:
Formula: per bucket: digest disk_read_bytes ÷ host_stats disk_read_bytes × 100, for the 10 digests with the most disk reads over the range.
Reading: above 20% (and node reads ≥ 5 MiB/s) a digest is a disk culprit; compare pagesPerCall in Top digests to tell misses from scans.

panels.title: Node CPU used and disk reads

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(toUInt32(window_end), greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s})) * greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}), 'UTC') AS time,
  100 * sum(node_cpu_used_ns) / nullIf(sum(cpu_count * dateDiff('second', window_start, window_end)) * 1e9, 0) AS cpuUsedPct,
  sum(disk_read_bytes) / greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}) / 1048576 AS diskReadMBs
FROM obs.host_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote})
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description:
Formula: per bucket over the selected hosts: cpuUsedPct = node_cpu_used_ns ÷ (cpu_count × window seconds × 1e9) × 100; diskReadMBs = physical-disk read bytes ÷ bucket seconds ÷ 1048576.
Reading: the context for the shares beside it: a 40% share of an idle node is not an overload. Roles in Top digests use 50% CPU and 5 MiB/s.

panels.title: CPU of the top 10 digests (cores)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(toUInt32(window_end), greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s})) * greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}), 'UTC') AS time, digest_id AS digest,
  sum(cpu_ns) / 1e9 / greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}) AS cores
FROM obs.mysql_digest_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote})
  AND digest_id IN (SELECT digest_id FROM obs.mysql_digest_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote})
                    GROUP BY digest_id ORDER BY sum(cpu_ns) DESC LIMIT 10)
GROUP BY time, digest ORDER BY time

panels.description:
Formula: per bucket: digest cpu_ns ÷ 1e9 ÷ bucket seconds (cores), for the 10 digests with the most CPU over the range, summed over the selected hosts.
Reading: absolute cores, independent of node size; a digest that jumps here and in '% of node CPU used' is the one to EXPLAIN.

panels.title: CPU regression vs 7 days earlier

targets.rawSql:
SELECT digest_id AS digest,
  sumIf(cpu_ns, $__timeFilter(window_end)) / 1e9 AS cpuSecNow,
  sumIf(cpu_ns, window_end >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND window_end < $__toTime - INTERVAL 7 DAY) / 1e9 AS cpuSecWeekAgo,
  cpuSecNow / greatest(cpuSecWeekAgo, 0.001) AS ratio
FROM obs.mysql_digest_stats
WHERE (window_end >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND host IN (${host:singlequote})
  AND ($__timeFilter(window_end) OR window_end < $__toTime - INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY digest_id HAVING cpuSecNow > 1 ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 30

panels.description:
Formula: per digest: CPU seconds in the selected range ÷ CPU seconds in the same range 7 days earlier (digests with > 1 CPU second now).
Reading: ratio ≫ 1 = the digest got more expensive or more frequent than last week (a new query shows a huge ratio); check calls in the drill-down.

panels.title: Calls per second and average latency

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(toUInt32(window_end), greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s})) * greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}), 'UTC') AS time, sum(calls) / greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}) AS callsPerSec,
  sum(cpu_ns) / greatest(sum(calls), 1) / 1e6 AS cpuMsAvg,
  sum(wall_ns) / greatest(sum(calls), 1) / 1e6 AS wallMsAvg,
  sum(runq_ns) / greatest(sum(calls), 1) / 1e6 AS runqMsAvg
FROM obs.mysql_digest_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND digest_id = '${digest}'
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description:
Formula: per bucket for the selected digest: calls ÷ bucket seconds; cpu, wall and run-queue ns per call ÷ 1e6 (ms).
Reading: more calls at the same cost = the caller changed; the same calls at a higher cpuMsAvg = the plan or the data changed.

panels.title: Where the digest's time goes (%)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(toUInt32(window_end), greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s})) * greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}), 'UTC') AS time,
  100 * sum(cpu_ns) / greatest(sum(wall_ns), 1) AS cpuPct,
  100 * sum(runq_ns) / greatest(sum(wall_ns), 1) AS cpuWaitPct,
  100 * sum(io_wait_ns) / greatest(sum(wall_ns), 1) AS diskWaitPct,
  100 * sum(redo_wait_ns) / greatest(sum(wall_ns), 1) AS commitWaitPct
FROM obs.mysql_digest_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND digest_id = '${digest}'
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description:
Formula: per bucket for the selected digest: cpu_ns, runq_ns, io_wait_ns and redo_wait_ns ÷ wall_ns × 100.
Reading: cpuPct high = the statement itself is expensive; cpuWaitPct high = a victim of CPU overload; diskWaitPct = buffer-pool misses or scans; commitWaitPct = redo-log fsync. The rest of 100% is locks, network or unmeasured; a missing line means not measured.

panels.title: Per host

targets.rawSql:
SELECT host, sum(calls) AS callCount, sum(cpu_ns) / 1e9 AS cpuSec,
  sum(wall_ns) / greatest(sum(calls), 1) / 1e6 AS wallMsAvg
FROM obs.mysql_digest_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND digest_id = '${digest}'
GROUP BY host ORDER BY cpuSec DESC

panels.description:
Formula: per host for the selected digest: calls, CPU seconds, and wall ns per call ÷ 1e6.
Reading: one host much slower than the others for the same statement points at that host (data, hardware, load), not the query.

panels.title: Latest slow queries (digest filter optional)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts, host, pid, latency_ms AS latencyMs, digest_id AS digest, query
FROM obs.mysql_slow_queries
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND ('${digest}' = '' OR digest_id = '${digest}')
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 200

panels.description:
Formula: the newest 200 statements slower than mysql.slow_query_threshold_ms; query is literal-free unless both sample-query privacy flags are on.
Reading: slow is not guilty: check victimOf in Top digests before tuning a slow statement.

panels.title: Slow queries per interval

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, host, count() AS slow
FROM obs.mysql_slow_queries
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host IN (${host:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, host ORDER BY time

panels.description:
Formula: count of slow statements per Grafana interval and host (one row per slow statement, so any bucket width is exact).
Reading: a burst on every host at once = shared cause (network, storage, a batch job); on one host = that host.

panels.title: Family CPU (avg)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(toUInt32(window_end), greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s})) * greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}), 'UTC') AS time, family, avg(cpu_percent_avg) AS cpu
FROM obs.family_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND family IN (${family:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, family ORDER BY time

panels.description:
Formula: per bucket: average of the family's cpu_percent_avg (CPU of all its processes ÷ CPUs × 100), averaged over the selected hosts.
Reading: which service burned CPU when; compare with mysqld to see whether MySQL was the heavy one.

panels.title: Family RSS (max)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(toUInt32(window_end), greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s})) * greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}), 'UTC') AS time, family, max(rss_bytes_max) AS rss
FROM obs.family_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND family IN (${family:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, family ORDER BY time

panels.description:
Formula: per bucket: the highest summed RSS of the family's processes on any selected host.
Reading: steady growth is a leak or a growing cache.

panels.title: Top families

targets.rawSql:
SELECT host, family, avg(cpu_percent_avg) AS cpuAvg, max(cpu_percent_max) AS cpuMax,
  max(rss_bytes_max) AS rssMax, max(processes_max) AS processes
FROM obs.family_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND family IN (${family:singlequote})
GROUP BY host, family ORDER BY cpuAvg DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description:
Formula: per host and family over the range: average and peak CPU %, peak RSS and peak process count.
Reading: cpuMax ≫ cpuAvg = bursty; a process count that keeps growing = a fork storm or leaked workers.

panels.title: Top inbound clients

targets.rawSql:
SELECT replaceRegexpOne(toString(peer_ip), '^::ffff:', '') AS peer, service_port AS port, family,
  sum(bytes_rx + bytes_tx) AS bytes, sum(conns_opened) AS conns
FROM obs.netflow_peer_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND family IN (${family:singlequote}) AND direction = 'inbound'
GROUP BY peer, port, family ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description:
Formula: per client IP, local port and family over the range: TCP bytes both ways and connections opened (peer :: / port 0 = overflow).
Reading: the clients behind the traffic; many connections with few bytes = no connection pool.

panels.title: Top outbound peers

targets.rawSql:
SELECT replaceRegexpOne(toString(peer_ip), '^::ffff:', '') AS peer, service_port AS port, family,
  sum(bytes_rx + bytes_tx) AS bytes, sum(conns_opened) AS conns
FROM obs.netflow_peer_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND family IN (${family:singlequote}) AND direction = 'outbound'
GROUP BY peer, port, family ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description:
Formula: per remote IP, service port and family over the range: TCP bytes both ways and connections opened.
Reading: the dependencies each service calls most.

panels.title: TCP throughput by direction

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(toUInt32(window_end), greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s})) * greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}), 'UTC') AS time, direction,
  sum(bytes_rx + bytes_tx) / greatest($__interval_s, ${flush_s}) AS bytesPerSec
FROM obs.netflow_peer_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND family IN (${family:singlequote})
GROUP BY time, direction ORDER BY time

panels.description:
Formula: per bucket: TCP bytes (both ways) ÷ bucket seconds, inbound vs outbound, for the selected families.
Reading: a change in inbound is a change in client demand; in outbound, in what the services fetch.

panels.title: Who talks to MySQL (inbound :3306)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT host, replaceRegexpOne(toString(peer_ip), '^::ffff:', '') AS client, sum(bytes_rx) AS bytesIn,
  sum(bytes_tx) AS bytesOut, sum(conns_opened) AS conns
FROM obs.netflow_peer_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND host IN (${host:singlequote}) AND direction = 'inbound' AND service_port = 3306
GROUP BY host, client ORDER BY bytesOut DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description:
Formula: per MySQL host and client IP over the range: bytes received (queries), sent (results) and connections opened on port 3306.
Reading: the client with the largest bytesOut fetches the biggest results; match it to a digest with a large bytes_out.

panels.title: Snapshots (fetch one with the query in deploy/grafana/README.md)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts, host, reason, verdict,
  JSONExtractString(report, 'mysql_report', 'overload_cause', 'verdict') AS overload,
  JSONExtractString(report, 'mysql_report', 'overload_cause', 'digest', 'digest_id') AS overloadDigest,
  length(report) AS reportBytes
FROM obs.diagnose_snapshots
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND host IN (${host:singlequote})
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description:
Formula: the newest 100 diagnose snapshots: why each was taken (reason), the I/O verdict, and overload_cause verdict and digest extracted from the stored report.
Reading: a snapshot is the exact /api/diagnose output at that moment; fetch the full report with the SQL in deploy/grafana/README.md.
